title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Behind the scenes release process update
summary: This release has no functional changes for users; it continues refining the internal script that drafts these release notes.

highlights.title: Release Notes Tooling
highlights.description: The internal script that drafts these release notes gained more test coverage and refinements, with no change to how the extension behaves.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Ships no changes to extension behavior: every command and setting works exactly as it did in 1.42.323.
The script that generates these release notes was refined and gained additional test coverage, aimed at more reliable notes in future releases.
